name: Damegane
source:
Takuto starts living at his cousin's house because of some reasons. There are three daughters, Tooko, Chikako and Ranko. He meets them for the first time in several years, but they are now all unsophisticated. Well, their battle for Takuto starts now!

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090813134736/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1013402]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
拓人因为某些原因开始寄住在表亲家。那里有三名女儿，分别是灯子、千佳子和兰子。他时隔数年再次见到三人，却发现她们如今都显得土里土气。围绕拓人的争夺战就此开始！

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090813134736/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1013402]ErogeShop[/url]]
